sources.title: [26.17] Victorious Twisted Fate Guide for Season 16 | Jammed

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.text: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

spells.name: Wild Cards
spells.text: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

spells.name: Pick a Card
spells.text: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

spells.name: Stacked Deck
spells.text: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

spells.name: Destiny
spells.text: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

archetype.value: Twisted Fate is an AP mage who uses waveclear, roams, and map control to create advantages.

axis.value: Twisted Fate pokes with Wild Cards and pushes waves to open roam opportunities.

winCondition.value: Twisted Fate wins through smart roams, vision control, and proactive map pressure.

spikes.why: Twisted Fate gains a tool for splitpushing and applying side-lane pressure.
Twisted Fate can reveal stealth and create picks around fights or objectives.
Twisted Fate can coordinate an ultimate with a gank when he reaches level 6.

bait.why: After Twisted Fate uses Wild Cards, its cooldown leaves him without that ability until it returns.
After Twisted Fate uses Pick a Card, its six-second cooldown prevents him from choosing another card.

mistakes.value: Twisted Fate gives up a source of bonus gold by failing to last-hit consistently.
Twisted Fate loses value by waiting for fights instead of creating advantages proactively.
Twisted Fate players make a mistake when they manage the wave poorly and cannot move first to an early skirmish.
